brief.label: Today's brief
brief.info: At 08:00 on every working day Claude writes a three-line brief from today's tasks, meetings and coming dates. With AI switched off, the same facts arrive as a plain summary.
brief.ask: What is today's brief based on?
brief.none: The brief is written at 08:00 on working days. You can have it written now.
brief.plain: This brief was made from your records without AI.
brief.off: The daily brief is switched off. Turn it on in Settings › Helpers, or have it written now.

overbooked.title: Too much for today.
overbooked.body: Planned {planned}, working time {work}. You could move a few tasks to tomorrow.

todo.title: Tasks
todo.empty: No tasks for today. Use Plan the day to pick from this week's work.

attention.title: Needs attention
attention.none: Nothing needs your attention right now.
attention.overdue: {count, plural, one {# overdue task} other {# overdue tasks}}
attention.filesToCheck: {count, plural, one {# file to check} other {# files to check}}
attention.toInbox: All suggestions are in the Inbox

recent.title: Pick up where you left off
recent.none: Files, notes and meetings you open appear here.

plan.title: Plan the day
plan.description: Pick what you will do today, put it in order and add how long it takes.

wrap.title: Wrap up the day
wrap.description: See what got done, move the rest to tomorrow and leave a line in your daily note.
wrap.moveHint: Ticked tasks move to the next working day.
wrap.reflectionPlaceholder: What went well, what was hard?
